methodology: An exact bridge ID can link a project title to the ArcGIS bridge record, which lists both DEO and CONG_DIST.

A bridge-record CONG_DIST is used only when title geography does not independently resolve and the label maps to exactly one current LEG roster entry. When sources disagree, the title-based result is retained.
The DEO is the bridge record’s source-listed office; a DEO is not assumed to map to one LEG because a DEO may cover multiple legislative districts.
Exact bridge ID with unique inventory point and full-span-plus-25m municipal clearance, or full measured road alignment with 25m clearance.
Single municipality, explicit qualified location agreement, current local crosswalk consensus and unique PH location DB identity required.
Old inventory positions and municipal boundaries require review if the asset moved or administrative coverage changed. No multi-place split is invented.
